theme.style: Dark Cyberpunk with Deep Purple Black, Electric Cyan, and Golden Win Accents

layout_and_grid.header: Sticky glassmorphic top header with z-50 (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#0F0C20]/85 border-b border-[#00E5FF]/20)
layout_and_grid.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-screen px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-8
layout_and_grid.bet_slip: Fixed right drawer on desktop / slide-up modal on mobile with sticky place-bet footer

key_features_and_flows: Authentication (Email + Password signup and quick demo login presets)
Virtual Coin Wallet (Play money balance display with bonus claim option)
Sports Betting Page (Live matches, simulated dynamic odds pulsation in cyan/green/red)
Dynamic Bet Slip (Multi-selection, stake input, potential payout calculation, single and parlay options)
Casino Games Suite (Cyber Slots reel, Cyber Dice risk slider, Cyber Roulette wheel)
My Bets History Tab (Active, Won, Lost bets with simulated cashout capabilities)
Full-Screen Golden Trophy Overlay (Triggers on winning bets with site name NexusBet, celebratory animations, win amount)
Admin Demo Event Manager (Create custom sports matches, manipulate odds live, finish events)

visual_enhancers.glow_effects: box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3) for active buttons and odds pills
visual_enhancers.win_overlay_effects: Full screen semi-transparent radial gradient backdrop with shimmering gold particle trophy, animated glowing text 'NEXUSBET WINNER'
visual_enhancers.odds_update_flash: Brief green border/bg flash on odds increase, red border/bg flash on odds decrease
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2) with subtle rounded-xl corners

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add specific transitions for transform and opacity.
Do not center-align the app container text alignment globally.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Ensure dark cyberpunk theme is consistently implemented across all screens.
Always test inputs, modals, bet placement, casino triggers, and trophy overlay using proper data-testid attributes.
